preconditions.description: The input must be a list of exactly two elements.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(bear, str) for bear in bears)
preconditions.description: Each element in the input list must be a string.

postconditions.description: The output must be one of the specified fur colors or 'unknown'.
If both bears are black, the offspring will be black.
If both bears are brown, the offspring will be brown.
If both bears are white, the offspring will be white.
If one bear is black and the other is brown, the offspring will be dark brown.
If one bear is black and the other is white, the offspring will be grey.
If one bear is brown and the other is white, the offspring will be light brown.

postconditions.expression: not any(bear in {'black', 'brown', 'white'} for bear in bears) == (return_value == 'unknown')
postconditions.description: If neither bear is black, brown, or white, the offspring's fur color is unknown.
